access-level.description: General access level, such as Read, Write, or Admin.

access-type.description: Access relationship type, such as Public, Cross-Account, or Federated.

condition.description: One complete policy condition serialized as a JSON name/value or name/values object per attribute, preserving value types and grouping.

privilege.description: One specific granted action or privilege per attribute.

description: One resource-centric access analysis result describing an access level, access type, granted privileges and policy conditions. Link the resource and accessor identities explicitly. Based on OCSF 1.9.0: https://schema.ocsf.io/1.9.0/objects/access_analysis_result.
name: access-analysis
